﻿$helpersPath = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..\..\Projects\Tooling\primitives\config-helpers.ps1'
. $helpersPath

$sampleJson = '{"a":null,"b":"value","c":{"d":"","e":"ok","arr":[1,2,3]}}'
Write-Host '--- Remove missing values JSON ---' -ForegroundColor Cyan
Remove-MissingValuesText -InputString $sampleJson -Format json -AsJson
Write-Host '--- Convert to text JSON ---' -ForegroundColor Cyan
Convert-ConfigToText -InputString $sampleJson -Format json -RemovePunctuation -IncludeTypeNames -AsJson
